summary: V2.2 review/consolidation policy is active for new work: every implementer must adversarially self-review its own exact diff before handoff. Low-risk docs/tests/bounded local validation may integrate after self-review plus exact-head CI and ownership. Normal production source gets one independent exact-head spot check. Reality/identity/schema/persistence/server-authority/multiplayer/control-plane or other trust-boundary work requires an independent full review. A complementary adversarial worker may satisfy the independent challenge when it reviewed the exact candidate head. Support/test/audit workers should prefer durable findings or commit handoffs into the lane's retained lineage instead of opening another main-targeting PR when consolidation is safe. Family completion integrators own rebase/reconciliation/merge sequencing and should close superseded PRs after useful work is retained.
evidence: The 25-worker run showed useful implementation output accumulating faster than main merges.

Existing GPT-5.6 Sol workers are capable of substantive self-audit; independent sessions are retained for context-independence on higher-risk boundaries rather than required ceremonially for every tiny PR.
Four family completion queues are now the preferred landing path while completion pressure is active.
